items.t: Coolant loss and white smoke from oil cooler or EGR cooler failure
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler and EGR cooler
items.note: If head gaskets are also damaged, owners report about $9,500 total.

items.t: Head gaskets blow on the 6.0L diesel
items.job: Replace head gaskets and install head studs
items.note: Shops usually replace the oil and EGR coolers at the same time, which adds cost.

items.t: Spark plug blows out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert, new plug and coil
items.note: Owners report $500–$3,000; the high end is when the head had to come off.

items.t: 6.0L diesel won't start from a failing injector control module
items.note: Owners report about $2,600 when other parts were replaced too.

items.t: 6.0L diesel hard to start when hot from high-pressure oil leaks
items.job: Reseal high-pressure oil rail plugs, standpipes or STC fitting
items.note: The fitting at the back of the engine takes far more labor than the rail plugs.

items.t: Turbo lag from sticking turbo vanes
items.job: Remove and clean turbo vanes, replace unison ring

items.t: Rough cold running from sticking injectors (stiction)
items.job: Treat with additive or replace sticking injectors
items.note: An additive and oil change is the low end; a full set of injectors is the high end.

items.t: 6.0L diesel may stall without warning (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Camshaft position sensor can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under the recall if it hasn't been done; otherwise a low-cost repair.

items.t: 7.3L diesel misfires from injector wiring
7.3L diesel hard start or stalling from pressure sensor or regulator
items.job: Replace ICP sensor or IPR valve

items.t: Exhaust smell and power loss from leaking turbo up-pipes
7.3L diesel hard to start in the cold from glow plugs
items.job: Replace glow plugs and test relay

items.t: Automatic transmission overheats and fails
Brakes shake, pull or wear rotors fast
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Owners report about $400–$500 per brake job.

items.t: Cruise control switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Power door locks stop working
Lights can fail from the steering column switch (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Battery ground wire can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Headlight switch may be hard to turn on (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
